settings.title: Cold for 24 hours
settings.text: Double-wall steel holds ice from morning to night, and tea hot for 12 hours.

settings.title: Tastes of nothing
settings.text: Food-grade steel and a neutral lid: water tastes like water, even after a month.

settings.title: Leak-proof, truly
settings.text: Toss it in a bag upside down. The lid seals with a silicone ring you can replace.

settings.title: Plastic-free
settings.text: Steel body, silicone seal, bamboo-fibre cap. Packed in recycled card.

settings.title: Guaranteed for life
settings.text: If the steel ever fails, we replace it. Spare lids and seals are always in stock.

settings.title: Six colours
settings.text: A powder coat that resists scratches and keeps its colour for years.

settings.heading: Made to be the last bottle you buy
settings.text: One product, thought through down to the lid.

settings.heading: Pick the one that feels like you

settings.title: Pressed from one sheet
settings.text: Food-grade stainless steel is drawn into shape, with no seam on the body.

settings.title: Vacuum sealed
settings.text: Two walls with the air pumped out between them: that is what keeps drinks cold or hot.

settings.title: Coated by hand
settings.text: A powder coat is applied and baked, then checked for scratches under bright light.

settings.title: Tested and packed
settings.text: Every bottle is filled, turned upside down and weighed before it is wrapped in recycled card.

settings.quote: I put ice in at 7 in the morning and it was still there at midnight. I have stopped buying anything else.
settings.name: Clara M.

settings.quote: It has been dropped down a rock face and only the paint has a mark. The lid still closes perfectly.
settings.name: Thomas R.

settings.quote: Finally one that does not taste of metal. I bought a second one in terracotta for my partner.
settings.name: Nadia K.

settings.question: How big is it?
settings.answer: 750 ml, 26 cm tall, and 7 cm wide so it fits most cup holders and bike cages.

settings.question: Can I put hot drinks in it?
settings.answer: Yes. Tea and coffee stay hot for 12 hours. Avoid fizzy drinks, which build pressure.

settings.question: Is it dishwasher safe?
settings.answer: The lid and seal are. We recommend washing the body by hand to keep the colour at its best.

settings.question: What if I do not like it?
settings.answer: Send it back within 30 days, used or not, and we refund the full price.

settings.heading: One bottle. Six colours. Thirty days to love it.
settings.text: Free delivery on every order, and a lifetime guarantee on the steel.
